# R749SI — All-time Walsh parity transport and exact time-window source rank

Date: 2026-11-12 Asia/Shanghai. Independent direct-research continuation of R749SG/R749SH in PR #2183. Source session MCP-4ff7d28c18aa4f34bb412f6087d8613d, registered Researcher EM-DIRECT-F5DC4E, Activity RA-C90B76621B9191DE224257C3 (initial session-start receipt research2-20261112T2239-r749sg-direct-start subsequently SUCCEEDED). This research note is author-side, not a native RESULT or independent review. No shared CLAIM was used.

## Model and provenance

Retain the exact frozen R749 signed-Port model from awdawmip/enterprise-math@a72226e2430ffa4786321ac86e7f0c599d5f0389; use the prior verified, immutable explicit constructions:
- R749SF source: @066958c8da10e4d67395f3c9b6942a8d9d26daa7, research_notes/portable_direct/2026-11-12_R749SF_EIGHT_LIFT_HIDDEN_SIGN_FILTER.md.
- R749SG and R749SH: @419a4abfed20150b84d8df1650d5578f5af2370a, research_notes/portable_direct/2026-11-12_R749SG_WALSH_LINEAGE_RANK_AND_MINIMAL_RESIDUAL.md and 2026-11-12_R749SH_TWO_TIME_PROVENANCE_WALSH_AND_REPAIR.md.

There are 120 directed unsigned supports (A,B), 8 signed lifts of each, 960 signed directed states. Write an arbitrary fixed legal unsigned observation word as e_t=(A_t,B_t), t=0,...,m, with e_{t+1}=(B_t,C_t). Its conditioned sign process X_t lives in {±1}^{A_t∪B_t}. All support words considered have strictly positive probability for the declared p∈[0,1]. At p=1 only forced steps are admissible. The observer likelihood is independent of the hidden lift (R749SF), so conditioning does not reweight the initial sign prior μ.

For each step let i_t be the old-only axis A_t\B_t, j_t the new-only axis C_t\B_t. A forced step is C_t=A_t△B_t, hence i_t=j_t, transporting the named sign by independent BSC with correlation θ=8p/(1+7p) and copying B_t's two signs. A nonforced step samples the new sign j_t as independent fair ±1 and copies B_t's two signs, discarding the old i_t. This remains true when a prior axis name reappears. A sign is a label/value on a typed Port, not signed branch mass; the conditional probabilities are nonnegative rational when p is rational.

## Theorem 1: all-time monomial-or-zero joint Walsh functional

For arbitrary observation times 0,...,m and arbitrary subsets S_t⊆A_t∪B_t, let χ_{S_t}(X_t)=∏_{a∈S_t}X_t(a). Define the backwards algorithm:
- Initialize W=∅ and c=1.
- For t=m,m−1,...,1, first set W←W△S_t (symmetric difference, cancelling duplicate time-labelled parity factors that meet at this time).
- Transport W backwards across e_{t−1}→e_t. If this is forced and j_{t−1}∈W, multiply c by θ and identify j_{t−1} with the earlier i_{t−1} (same named axis). Other signs copy.
- If this is nonforced and j_{t−1}∈W, return zero. Otherwise transport the remaining B_{t−1}-axes unchanged. The old-only sign is absent from this pullback.
- At t=0, set W←W△S_0.

If no nonforced zero test occurred, then

 E_μ[∏_{t=0}^m χ_{S_t}(X_t) | observed word] = c · μ̂(W),

where μ̂(W)=E_μ[χ_W(X_0)]. The coefficient is c=θ^k, for a nonnegative integer k counting forced selected-sign passages before parity cancellation; otherwise the expectation is exactly zero. For p=0 an exponent k>0 gives zero, and for p=1 all steps are forced.

Proof: Apply conditional expectation backwards, multiplying by the time-t Walsh character *before* eliminating the innovation at that step. In a forced step, for the carried sign y, E[y|x]=θx and other two signs are deterministic copies, so each Walsh character pulls back to θ^δ times a prior Walsh character. In a nonforced step, E[y_j|past]=0 and y_j is independent fair; a selected new sign gives zero, while other signed axes copy. Multiplication of characters satisfies χ_U χ_V=χ_{U△V}. Induction through m steps ends at μ̂(W). This proof covers arbitrary length and arbitrary initial sign prior, with fixed observed support word.

The time ordering in the algorithm is load-bearing: an innovation sign appearing at t and again at t+1 can cancel when two signed observations are multiplied, whereas an isolated innovation in a single-time query is invisible.

## Theorem 2: exact minimal expectation coordinates for any finite time-joint query family

Fix p, an admissible word, and a finite family Q of joint Walsh-product queries of the form in Theorem 1. Apply its backward algorithm to each query. Discard queries with coefficient c=0; collapse repeated nonempty initial Walsh index W to one initial coordinate μ̂(W), with normalization μ̂(∅)=1 known. If U is the set of distinct surviving nonempty W, then exactly |U| independent affine source expectation coordinates are necessary and sufficient to answer all Q for arbitrary priors μ on the eight-lift initial cube. Necessity follows because the distinct Walsh functions χ_W (W≠∅) are linearly independent affine observables over the interior of the probability simplex, and their nonzero scalar rescalings remain independent. This is a sharp affine statistical carrier result for the declared query family; no claim about arbitrary nonlinear bit encoding or unknown-p joint inference.

## Theorem 3: the window starts where provenance recoverability is determined

Fix a positive-probability support word and 0≤a≤b≤m. Let K_{0→a,p} be the 8×8 conditional kernel from X_0 to X_a and H_{a:b,p} the kernel from X_0 to the *jointly observed* signed time-window Z=(X_a,...,X_b). Then

    rank(H_{a:b,p}) = rank(K_{0→a,p}) = 2^{r_p(ω_{0:a})},

where r_p(ω_{0:a}) is R749SG's count (0..3) of live original sign lineages at the first recorded time a, with zero-correlation forced transfers at p=0 counted as erased.

Proof: By the conditional Markov property, H=K_{0→a}L_{a:b}, where L maps a signed state X_a to its joint future window, including the first X_a as a literal coordinate. The marginalization map M from the joint window back to X_a satisfies L M=I_8. Hence K=H M, so rank(K)≤rank(H); the factorization gives rank(H)≤rank(K). R749SG proves rank(K)=2^{r_p}. The image of the initial-probability affine simplex therefore has dimension 2^{r_p}−1. Later window observations cannot restore original lineages already erased before a; adding later observations also does not cause information loss about the first explicitly retained signed state X_a.

This theorem is distinct from merely retaining the final current sign distribution: a time window reaching back before a reset may preserve past/current joint relations even if the final eight-state marginal has rank one.

### Exact witness

At p=1/2, let the unsigned word be
{0,1} → {1,2} → {2,3} → {3,4} → {4,5},
giving e_0=({0,1},{1,2}), e_1=({1,2},{2,3}), e_2=({2,3},{3,4}), e_3=({3,4},{4,5}). Each update is nonforced. Ranks of a joint window starting at a=0,1,2,3 are respectively 8,4,2,1, independently of its ending time b≥a.

The new axis 3 at e_1 is fair and absent from initial lineage; nevertheless it is copied at e_2 and
 E[X_1(3) X_2(3) | ω]=1,
where E[X_1(3)]=E[X_2(3)]=0 for a centered prior. Thus the joint parity distinguishes an actual reuse of fresh signed-port provenance; the final one-time marginals alone miss this two-time relationship.

## Exact validation and scope

The Python standard-library Fraction checker R749SI_MULTITIME_WALSH_WINDOW_CHECK.py reconstructs all 120 directed unsigned supports and their eight signed lifts. For p=0 and p=1/2 it verifies all 960 single-step support words, all 64 Walsh product queries on two times, and all eight initial sign lifts (983040 exact equalities). For those p it also verifies all 64 two-step words from one fixed directed support, all 512 three-time Walsh product queries, and eight lifts (524288 exact equalities). At p=1 it checks all 120 positive-probability forced one-step words, all 64 two-time Walsh queries and eight lifts (61440 equalities). It checks 384 exact rational 8×8 rank calculations for all 64 two-step words at p=0 and p=1/2 with three possible window starting times, and the explicit fresh-sign cross-time witness. All tested assertions PASS. These are finite checks of the algebraically proved all-length identities, not a stand-in for induction.

The scope is the R749SF abstract signed-Port conditional kernel. It is an exact, path-conditioned, provenance-sensitive observer calculation. Promotion to a native Cell/Link/Port three-force PASS requires an explicit event guard/witness under V29/V39 and remains an independent issue.

## Durable next question

Find the smallest *adaptive* observed-support policy class for which the support-word likelihood remains independent of hidden signs and the above monomial-or-zero pullback survives unchanged; when a policy selects supports based on signed or past hidden emissions, derive the exact likelihood-weighted rational Walsh expansion and its minimal state. Separately test a real V29/V39 event permissioned triadic closure witness.
